overview: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?
title: The Spiral

data.overview: La trama ruota attorno a una donna che si presenta all’improvviso a casa di sua figlia per raccontarle la verità sulla loro famiglia, segnata da un patto stretto molti anni prima con un’estranea. Un segreto custodito troppo a lungo, che ora torna a reclamare il suo prezzo.

data.overview: Durant un orage, Anna se présente à l’improviste dans l’appartement étudiant de sa fille Alice et lui révèle que toute leur histoire familiale repose sur un mensonge qu’elle lui a raconté. Anna affirme avoir passé un pacte avec un mystérieux inconnu pour sauver la jambe d’Alice après un accident survenu vingt ans plus tôt. Ce pacte aurait déclenché un effet domino entraînant des événements terribles au fil des années. Seule Alice peut réparer les choses. Mais à quel prix ?
